name: Meteoroids
author: Jeremy Zeiber
description: An Asteroids-style shooter: move your ship, blast the meteoroids and steer clear of them. Use the arrows and buttons, or mouse and touch, to move and shoot.

descriptions.en: An Asteroids-style shooter: move your ship, blast the meteoroids and steer clear of them. Use the arrows and buttons, or mouse and touch, to move and shoot.
descriptions.it: Uno sparatutto in stile Asteroids: muovi la navicella, distruggi i meteoroidi ed evitali. Usa frecce e pulsanti, oppure mouse o tocco, per muoverti e sparare.
